## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see.

## Problem or motivation

What problem does this solve? What is the current limitation or pain point?

## Proposed solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Include any relevant UI/UX ideas.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you have considered and why you prefer your proposed solution.

## Additional context

Any other context, screenshots, mockups, or references that would help explain the feature.
